messages._comment: 2. FSKTM 3D PRINTING SURVEY - TEXT-ONLY ANNOUNCEMENT (Marcus -> Source Group)

message.conversation:
Greetings to all students of the Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology (FSKTM), UPM!

As part of an initiative to enhance students' academic experience and encourage innovation, a survey is being conducted regarding the PROPOSED 3D PRINTING FACILITIES FOR ACADEMIC PURPOSES AND STUDENT INNOVATION PROJECTS AT FSKTM, UPM.

Therefore, all FSKTM students are encouraged to participate in this survey to help us identify students' needs and demand for 3D Printing facilities, particularly for academic assignments, Final Year Projects (FYP), prototyping and innovation projects. The survey also aims to gather students' opinions on the proposed pricing and payment structure for the facilities.

Your feedback and participation are valuable in strengthening this proposal and supporting the effort to make 3D Printing facilities accessible to FSKTM students.

Let's make this initiative a reality! 👇

🔗 Google Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdIG82BWwDRFpwujs_uWzJNpj89PqmgNO87eRQnj9UcJCRQ5Q/viewform?usp=publish-editor

Thank you for your time and support!

_Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology_ _Representative_
_Students’ Union_
_Universiti Putra Malaysia_
_2026/2027 Academic Session_
